feature_contract.goal: Complete DrawIndexedPrimitiveUP performance improvement by removing redundant index scanning across both 16-bit and 32-bit stereo paths while retaining correct full bilateral draw and safe original D3D9 fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R30 UP producer only; do not modify VB/IB, main-menu, HUD, lens, SkyGlow, FFB, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: R30 checks the declared vertex window, builds the unique index mask once and feeds per-eye XYZRHW transforms.
R29 raw UP draw replays both eyes; malformed caller input declines the stereo override and retains original D3D9 fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: One index walk handles both supported widths while preserving left and right eye transform and touched-list semantics.
Zero, oversized, overflowing or out-of-window index declarations reject injection to original D3D9; positive and negative differential tests remain green.
DX9Ex Active full Win32 game/host/package and Domain Isolation for the exact material SHA; no Quest3 visual/fps claim.

diagnosis.root_cause: R30 UP index path loops through the same 16/32-bit index data twice: max-index scan and sparse-mask construction, despite a caller-declared valid D3D9 index window.
source_trace: R30 per-eye transforms and R29 raw left/right draw
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Replace max-index loop with a checked 64-bit declared window; validate each index while populating the sparse mask.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: 2000 deterministic randomized 16/32-bit in-range cases, outside-range and overflow fallback, six destructive source mutations.
diagnosis.protected_behaviors: Stereo both eyes, legal D3D9 min/count, desktop fallback, world/HUD, SkyGlow, FFB.
diagnosis.measurement_limitation: CPU loop count improved in source; Quest3/VDXR frame-time, HMD graphics and 72Hz remain untested.
